name: RideFlux
summary: See electric-unicycle telemetry and alerts on your phone and Rokid HUD.
description: RideFlux connects an Android phone to an electric unicycle over BLE and can send speed, battery, temperature, and ride alerts to the Rokid HUD. It also provides live charts, wheel parameters, and trip recording. The author develops and tests it with a Begode A2 and Rokid RV101; support for other wheel protocols has varying validation levels. Install the phone app and the separate glasses HUD. Both APKs require Android 9 or later.
author: zero2005x
